findings.evidence: We log the IP address (the location on the Internet) of the computer or network from which someone visits the website. We also use IP addresses in the aggregate to track traffic so that we can evaluate and improve the website.
findings.rationale: The policy does not explicitly state that IP addresses are shared with third parties, but it does mention logging and using them for internal purposes.
